cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SelaNativeSharedFixture C)
add_library(selafixture SHARED library.c)
target_link_options(selafixture PRIVATE "LINKER:--version-script,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/exports.map")
add_executable(probe probe.c)
target_link_libraries(probe PRIVATE selafixture)
